name: OpenEP
description: OpenEP moves beyond binary yes/no prediction questions to open-ended outcome prediction, requiring models to generate free-text descriptions of how future events will unfold. It evaluates whether LLMs can produce plausible, detailed narratives about uncertain futures rather than just assigning probabilities.
reputation: Introduced in 2024 as a novel framing for forecasting evaluation; cited in the context of expanding beyond accuracy-only metrics.
notes: Addresses a gap in forecasting benchmarks that rely on binary or multiple-choice formats; open-ended generation makes automated evaluation harder and requires human or LLM judges.
